title: Source registry + license register; clear ≥3 sources (PD/CC/ODbL/operator)
context: Before any data source can be ingested into food-assistance-maps, it must be registered in a source registry and cleared by a licensing reviewer. OpenStreetMap is ODbL (attribution + share-alike for databases); US federal government works are generally public domain; state/local portals and HSDS publishers vary and must be verified individually. A source that fails the license gate is never ingested. This register is the auditable front door of the entire pipeline and gates food-maps-pilot-004.
objective: Produce a structured source registry and license register documenting ≥3 food-assistance data sources, each with: name, URL, license/terms, attribution string, shareAlike flag, retrieval method (API/download/scrape), PII risk assessment, and ingestible status (cleared/blocked). At least one source must be OSM (ODbL), one a US federal or state government open-data portal (PD or CC), and one an operator's own published page or an HSDS feed.
acceptanceCriteria: ≥3 sources registered with name, URL, license/terms, attribution string, shareAlike flag, retrieval method, PII risk, and ingestible status
OSM is recorded as ODbL (attribution + share-alike) with the correct attribution string '© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL'
At least one US federal government source is recorded as public domain (with a note that state/local portals must be verified individually)
Each HSDS feed or state/local portal has its license individually verified — not assumed open
No source whose robots.txt or terms of service forbid the intended reuse is marked ingestible
The register documents how data_license is set per source (ODbL for OSM-derived, verified license for others)
A licensing reviewer (distinct from the researcher) has signed off on each cleared source
The register is stored in a machine-readable format (JSON or CSV) alongside a human-readable summary document
output: data/sources/registry.json (machine-readable source registry) + docs/license-register.md (human-readable license register summary) listing ≥3 cleared sources with complete provenance fields.
